cohort: 60 antenatal mothers in their last trimester (28-39 weeks gestation), aged 18-40 years, attending an antenatal clinic at Velammal Medical College and Hospital, Madurai, Tamil Nadu.
finding: Multiparous women had a higher prevalence of Generalized Anxiety Disorder and Dysthymic Disorder, while primiparous women had a higher prevalence of Depressive Disorder; increased anxiety and depressive symptoms correlated with stressful life events and poorer marital quality, and mothers with previous obstetric and neonatal complications had a higher prevalence of psychiatric morbidities.
